content.title: Will Robinhood's Vlad Tenev debate AMC's Adam Aron on stock tokens?
content.description: Robinhood (HOOD) Chairman and CEO Vlad Tenev sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss his public feud with AMC (AMC) CEO Adam Aron, who threatened legal action and argued against Robinhood's tokenized AMC stock.

content.title: Crypto Kicks Off Q4 With More Momentum Than Stocks or Gold: Which Will Carry Bitcoin, XRP, or Solana the Furthest?
content.summary: Bitcoin broke its worst seasonal pattern, XRP is drawing fresh institutional money, and Solana is quietly outpacing both on a key metric that tends to predict which coin moves first when a rally gets real.

content.title: A Senate Bill Would Make Small Stablecoin Purchases Tax-Free and Close Crypto’s Wash-Sale Loophole. What Changes for Bitcoin and XRP Holders?
content.summary: Congress is pushing to reshape crypto taxes in two significant ways, and Bitcoin and XRP holders could feel the squeeze before year-end. One proposed change might cost some investors a tax strategy they have relied on for years.

content.title: Bitcoin Crossed $85,000 on Cooler Inflation Data, Then Lost It the Same Day. Why Does Bitcoin Keep Failing at $85,000?
content.summary: Bitcoin surged past $85,000 on promising inflation news, then gave it all back within hours. Three forces keep colliding every time buyers push the price to that level, and until one of them breaks, the pattern shows no signs of stopping.

content.title: Lion Group Sells Solana to Invest in Hyperliquid: A Smart Move or a Risky One?
content.summary: Lion Group just dumped its Solana and part of its Bitcoin to double down on a single exchange token while whales are actively selling it. Whether that bet pays off hinges on a few critical price levels and a regulatory decision that could change everything.

content.title: Should You Buy Solana or Bitcoin With $1,000?
content.summary: Bitcoin and Solana have taken very different paths over the past year, and the one that lost less is not necessarily the one positioned to grow your retirement savings the most.

content.title: Could XRP Reach $25 by 2030? Walking Through the Math
content.summary: XRP just posted a 46% gain in 90 days, and some holders are already eyeing a price that would put it nearly on par with Bitcoin's entire market value. Walking through the math reveals just how many things would have to go right to get there.

content.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction for October 2026
content.summary: Bitcoin has surged nearly 44% over the past three months, but a perfect storm of rising oil prices, slowing ETF inflows, and a Federal Reserve meeting that could change everything threatens to unravel the rally before October is over.
